Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Fabricația de semiconductori, Fabricația de computere și echipamente electronice și Dezvoltare de software
Shape the Security Behind Millions of Connected Devices
 How do you protect an ePassport, payment chip, secure element, connected vehicle, or IoT device against sophisticated attackers?
 At NXP's Competence Center Crypto & Security, you'll join a global team of security architects, cryptographers, and embedded security experts who help build secure, trusted, and certifiable products used worldwide.
 We're looking for an experienced Product Security Architect with a passion for embedded security, secure software design, and solving complex security challenges.
 What You'll Do
Define, review, and improve security architectures for embedded software, firmware, operating systems, and secure platforms.
Perform threat modeling, risk assessments, and attack surface analysis.
Investigate security vulnerabilities, identify root causes, and define countermeasures.
Support security-by-design throughout the product lifecycle.
Collaborate with customers, development teams, certification bodies, and security evaluation labs.
Contribute to innovative security solutions for next-generation connected products.
 What You'll Bring
Master's or PhD in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
Strong embedded software development experience in C/C++.
Solid background in embedded security and secure system design.
Experience with security architecture, threat analysis, or vulnerability assessments.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
 Ideally, You Also Have Experience With
Smart Cards, Secure Elements, Java Card, or Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs)
Common Criteria (CC), EMVCo, SESIP, or similar certification schemes
Cryptography, Secure Boot, Key Management, HSMs, or Firmware Protection
Secure Coding, Threat Modeling, and Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC) practices
 Why Join NXP?
 Your Work Will Help Secure Technologies Used In
Digital Identity & ePassports
Payment & Secure Elements
Automotive & Industrial Systems
IoT & Connected Edge Devices
Next-Generation Secure Platforms
 Think like an attacker. Build trust by design. Shape the future of secure embedded systems.
 For applications in Gratkorn: NXP provides market competitive compensation according to the benchmarking of the electronic and semiconductor industry. Due to the Austrian Equal Treatment Act we are obligated to state the employment group of our applicable collective bargaining agreement (CBA) “Kollektivvertrag für Angestellte Gewerbe und Handwerk und in der Dienstleistung“, this position (fulltime) is graded in Employment Group V after 6 years. Your individual experiences and expectations will be considered in the application process. Moreover, we provide attractive benefits to our employees like home office, flexible working time, meal benefits and more.
